name: arch body hold
description: A face-down hold with arms, chest and legs lifted off the floor, the mirror of the hollow hold. It builds the lower back, glutes and upper back.
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your arms reaching overhead.
Squeeze your glutes and press your hips into the floor.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres at the same time.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor just ahead of you.
Breathe steadily and hold the shape without bending your knees.
